When Should I Start Taking a Collagen Supplement?

It’s a question that everyone asks before taking Ingenious Collagen+, When should I start taking collagen supplements? Is it too late?!

The simple answer? There’s no time like the present. All our experts agree on that. But let’s delve a little deeper into this subject so that you can make your own choice?

 

What does collagen actually do?

Collagen is the most plentiful protein found in our bodies and is responsible for many things, including helping to keep our skin, bones and joints nice and healthy. As such, collagen has a huge impact on the signs of ageing. According to our Ingenious Collagen+ experts, an improved collagen level contributes to:

  • Healthier skin that is more hydrated and more elastic
  • A noticeable reduction in wrinkles and fine lines
  • Stronger and thicker hair and nails
  • Suppler joints and increased vitality

However, once we reach our mid-20s, our ability to replenish collagen stores starts to fall by 1.5% each year. We know what you’re thinking, that does seem a bit young! Well, Mother Nature has other ideas.

This means that by the time we are in our 40s, we could potentially see a 30% reduction in our body’s collagen levels. In our 50s, 60s and 70s the signs really start to show, inside and out.

How can I improve my collagen levels?

Try as we may to avoid it, we are all ageing. We are getting older every day and, let’s admit it, age is more than just a number. And the bigger that number, the more it shows in our skin, our hair, our activity levels. But what if there was a way to slow the process?

Why should I take collagen supplements?

If you’re still in your 20s, introducing the correct collagen supplement into your diet will make the world of difference. The results might not be instantaneous but your future self will be thankful!

Over the age of 25? Not to worry! In fact, there’s some great news here too. Taking a high-quality supplement can actively replenish your collagen stores and work to reduce further losses. By starting with the correct supplement now, you’ll begin to see improvements in the condition of your skin, hair, nails and joints. And it doesn’t take long to notice the difference!

Yes, regardless of your age, if you consume a high-quality collagen supplement then you’ll be working to improve your body ? inside and out.

What makes Ingenious Collagen+ so ingenious?

Ingenious Collagen+ is the only supplement to solve the issue of collagen breaking down in the stomach before it can be optimally absorbed by your body.

The special delivery system ensures the Ingenious Collagen+ reaches the best part of the body for maximal collagen uptake.
